links.outcome: Prospective silent-mode performance versus retrospective test performance, MSBOS, and clinician preordering
links.effect: Silent prospective validation (n=24,003) maintained AUROC 0.94 and AUPRC 0.55 (test: 0.94, 0.57); sensitivity 0.72 and PPV 0.34, surpassing MSBOS and clinician behavior.
links.quote: Silent prospective validation (n=24,003, transfusion rate 2.18%, 95% CI, 2.07 to 2.46) maintained a 0.94 (95% CI, 0.92 to 0.95) AUROC and a 0.55 (95% CI, 0.51 to 0.60) AUPRC.

links.outcome: Model performance compared with MSBOS and clinician RBC preordering on same cases
links.effect: Prospective sensitivity 0.72 and PPV 0.34, surpassing both MSBOS and clinician behavior; hybrid model MAE 12.86 vs 13.34 for MSBOS on daily RBC needs.
links.quote: Prospectively, the model's sensitivity was 0.72 (95% CI, 0.67 to 0.75) and its positive predictive value was 0.34 (95% CI, 0.31 to 0.37), surpassing both MSBOS and clinician behavior.

screen.reason: The study evaluates a predictive risk model (Smart Match) integrated into real-time clinical workflows for perioperative transfusion needs via silent prospective validation against existing clinical practices (MSBOS and clinician preordering).
